# Wrecked Metal v0.1.4 — Parallax Snow

Upgraded snowfall on the glacier track.

> **You need your own ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets, exactly like the earlier betas.

## New

- **New snow:** thicker, softer flakes in three layers of depth that drift and sway on the glacier track, with the near ones sweeping past the camera.
- **Experimental random weather (off by default):** an early rain, thunderstorm and synthesized thunder system is included in `Data/wm_tuning.ini` (`[weather]`, set `random_weather = 1` to try it) while it is refined over time. **Play Fidelity** keeps the original N64 weather.

## Install

Download the APK below and install it over the previous version: your settings, save and ROM are kept.

**Requirements:** Android 10+, Vulkan, and a device that can run 32-bit apps (this build is `armeabi-v7a`).

## Support

Wrecked Metal is free and will stay free. If you'd like to support the work, tips are welcome on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/costelinha_games). Entirely voluntary, and nothing is locked behind them.
